notes.title: My Beautiful Paper Smile is available NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today is a very big day. On this day, June 19, 2020, I’ve released my first major commercial project, and V Publishing has released their debut game, My Beautiful Paper Smile. While this is just the Early Access launch, it’s a massive milestone to have finally reached, and we’re so excited to finish out the rest of this journey with you!

My Beautiful Paper Smile has been under development for almost three years. Things started slow, and as the game grew and matured, so did the interest around it. I want to give a huge thank you to everyone that has been looking forward to this release and has been supporting its development. It’s a dream come true to make it this far. There are lots of exciting things that we have planned for the future, and we’ll be sharing more as time goes on.

To celebrate the launch, the game will be 10% off for the next week! That'll bring the price down to $13.49. When you buy the Early Access version of the game, you’ll get instant access to the first two chapters, and you’ll get the rest of the game for free once it’s finished. We’ll also be doing a live stream later today right here on the Steam store page! Come stop by the page at 5:00 PM EDT (2:00 PM PDT) to chat and watch us play the first chapter of My Beautiful Paper Smile. It’ll be lots of fun, so hopefully, we’ll see you then.

As well as the sale and live stream, until the 22nd you’ll be able to download our demo! If you’re still a little unsure and want to get a feel for the game before purchasing, you can play the first half of Chapter 1 to see what all the fuss is about.

That’s all for now folks. Thank you all so much for reading and checking out the game!

Until next time, Keep Smiling :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036700/My_Beautiful_Paper_Smile/

notes.title: Spanish and German Translations Have Been Added
notes.notes:

Today I get to announce that Spanish and German translations have been added to [b]My Friend is a Raven![/b]

Now when you play, you'll find translation options on the main menu.  Simply select your preferred language, and all the text will be updated.

notes.title: 'My Friend is a Raven' is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

My Friend is a Raven is a game I created for a recent game jam, and published on itch.io, where it gained lots of popularity.  And today, it has been approved for release on Steam!  In just a few weeks, an updated and improved version of the game will be available to download for free!
